title: Data Engineer - Business Analytics
description:
**job overview:**

**we are seeking a dynamic and detail\-oriented** **data engineer – business analytics** **to join our team. this role is responsible for designing, building, and optimizing analytics\-ready datasets within a modern data platform leveraging databricks.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


the ideal candidate will serve as a bridge between data engineering and business analytics—transforming raw, disparate data into trusted, performant, and governed datasets that enable enterprise reporting and self\-service analytics.


this role will focus on developing and maintaining curated **silver and gold layer data assets within a medallion architecture**, where the **semantic layer resides in databricks rather than bi tools**. you will partner closely with business stakeholders, data architects, and analytics teams to ensure alignment with business logic, kpis, and enterprise data standards.

**please note: although a specific location is displayed in our applicant tracking system, this position is fully remote and may be performed from anywhere within the united states.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**key responsibilities:**

**data engineering \& modeling**

* design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and curated datasets within the **databricks lakehouse (silver and gold layers)**.
* develop and manage **analytics\-ready data models and semantic structures in databricks**, aligned to enterprise reporting needs.
* transform raw data into business\-consumable datasets that reflect standardized definitions, kpis, and metrics.
* apply dimensional modeling and other data modeling techniques within a distributed data environment.

**semantic layer \& analytics enablement**

* own the **semantic layer within databricks**, ensuring consistent definitions across reporting and analytics use cases.
* enable downstream consumption by visualization and analytics tools (e.g., power bi) without reliance on embedded semantic modeling.
* partner with business analysts and reporting teams to optimize datasets for usability, performance, and scalability.

**performance optimization \& data quality**

* optimize datasets and data models for performance, including query efficiency and scalability for enterprise reporting workloads.
* ensure data quality, integrity, and consistency across the full data lifecycle.
* implement and enforce data governance standards, including data security, masking, access controls and cost controls.

**collaboration \& business alignment**

* work closely with business leaders and stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable data solutions.
* align data structures to enterprise data dictionary and kpi definitions.
* communicate data model designs and dataset structures clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

**platform \& modernization**

* support the evolution of the enterprise analytics platform within azure and databricks.
* contribute to best practices for ci/cd, deployment automation, and data engineering standards.
* assist in advancing data capabilities, including support for ai/ml use cases where applicable.

**qualifications**

* bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, business analytics, or a related field.
* 6\+ years of experience in **data engineering, data modeling, or analytics engineering** roles.
* strong expertise in **databricks unity catalog, sql, and python** for data transformation and pipeline development.
* proven experience designing and implementing **data models within modern data platforms (e.g., lakehouse architecture)**.
* experience working with **medallion architecture (bronze/silver/gold layers)**.
* understanding of bi tools (e.g., power bi), with emphasis on dataset consumption rather than semantic layer ownership.
* experience with **ci/cd pipelines, version control, and deployment processes**.
* familiarity with agile/scrum delivery methodologies.

**skills and competencies**

* strong data modeling and analytical thinking skills.
* ability to translate business requirements into scalable data solutions.
* deep understanding of data transformation, optimization, and performance tuning.
* excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* high attention to detail with a focus on data accuracy and quality.
* ability to lead initiatives and influence cross\-functional teams.
* adaptability in a fast\-paced, evolving data environment.

**working conditions**

* this position may require occasional travel.
* flexible work hours may be necessary to meet project deadlines.

**pay equity**

**$135,000 \- $155,000**

at our core, we believe quality is never an accident — it is the result of intentional and intelligent effort.


**what you will do in the position:**


* test design \& execution

	+ perform black\-box and gray\-box testing on released products and products under development
	+ identify design and implementation defects

	+ functional, integration, and regression testing at both feature and system levels
	+ end\-to\-end testing of iot devices and systems
	+ distributed system validation (device\-edge\-cloud)

	+ protocols: mqtt, websockets

	+ firmware \+ ota update validation

	+ experience with modern frameworks: playwright / postman / cucumber / behave

	+ containerized test execution: docker\-based test environments
	+ api \+ contract testing: pact, schema validation

	+ leverage ai/ml tools to:
		- generate test cases from requirements/specifications
		- identify test gaps and improve coverage
		- perform intelligent defect clustering and prioritization
	+ use genai tools (e.g., copilot, llms) to:
		- auto\-generate test scripts (playwright/python)
		- assist in debugging and root cause analysis
	+ apply prompt engineering best practices for test generation and validation workflows

	+ track and manage defects using bug tracking systems
	+ analyze test results and perform:
		- troubleshooting
		- issue triage
		- root cause analysis
	+ collaborate cross\-functionally to drive resolution
* process and collaboration
	+ contribute to and improve quality engineering processes and initiatives
	+ work closely with:
		- developers
		- product managers
		- qa engineers
	+ advocate for testing best practices and influence system architecture

**what it takes to succeed**



to be successful in this role, you should:


* approach problems with critical and analytical thinking
* ability to leverage ai tools to improve productivity
* bias for automation first \+ shift\-left testing
* strong system\-level thinking
* demonstrate rigor, persistence, and ownership in completing assignments
* effectively communicate your ideas both verbally and in writing
* actively participate in team discussions and meetings

* ba/bs in computer science, computer engineering, or related field
* 0\-3 years of experience in:
	+ quality engineering
	+ test automation
	+ software and/or hardware testing

**preferred qualifications**


* experience with ai\-assisted development or qa tools (e.g., github copilot, llm\-based workflows)
* experience testing ai/ml systems or data\-driven applications
* knowledge of iot protocols (mqtt)
* familiarity with edge computing platforms (e.g., nvidia jetson, arm\-based systems)
* experience with containerized test environments and ci/cd pipelines
* exposure to observability platforms and production monitoring


**technical experience**


* testing iot devices
* services and protocol testing (http, json, rest apis)
* applications running on linux platforms
* automation scripting (e.g., python)
* test frameworks such as playwright and postman


**tools \& methodologies**


* agile software development environment experience
* familiarity with tools such as:
	+ jira

	+ confluence

**core skills**


* strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* excellent planning and organizational abilities
* clear and effective written and verbal communication

description:

about us  

  

we are a well established, fast\-paced custom software development agency working on client projects in a variety of industries including health care, education, environmental engineering \& insurance. you will play a critical role in the architecture, design, development, testing, and deployment of cloud/web/mobile software in a myriad of technologies. along with your close\-knit team of colleagues, you'll see your creations take life in ways that can only happen in the dynamic world of software consultancy.
  

  

why settle for being a factory worker as a "coder" in a product company where you never get to see the light of day and no one cares about who you are or what you aspire to be. it's time to be a bigger fish in a smaller pond, go beyond technical geekdom and be part of an amazing team of software design \& development consultants.  

  

why join us?
  

  

we offer top notch company culture, employee benefits, career growth, and have a trusted brand in our market.  

* competitive base salary \+ bonus
* medical, dental, vision coverage on day 1 of employment
* generous 401k match and employer contribution
* generous pto \+ 8 company paid holidays
* huge emphasis on work\-life balance \- 40 hour weeks!
* remote work opportunities and flexible working hours
* extensive training and career development opportunities

  

job details:  

  

we are looking for a .net software engineer to work with microsoft/azure technologies in a team environment using industry standard best\-practices. an exemplary applicant will have a strong knowledge of the .net framework in the c\# languages, an ability to work on several projects at once, the skills to professionally troubleshoot issues, the ability to work independently, and the acumen to work with customers directly. in this role you will apply the principles of software engineering to design, develop, maintain, test and deploy client software projects all while keeping your sights on solving business problems. we are looking for someone who is innovative, self\-driven, has a strong technical focus combined with a team\-oriented attitude.  

  

candidates must be willing to work hybrid onsite at our cohoes, ny office.  

or  

we would ideally like someone willing to work hybrid onsite at our cohoes, ny office, but we are willing to consider est based remote workers who are able to visit our office with some frequency.
  

  

qualifications:* bachelor's degree in computer science, related field or equivalent experience
* 3\+ years of software development experience on modern microsoft platforms including c\#, asp.net core, razor, blazor, minimal apis / web apis, and .net 8/9 (lts)
* experience building and architecting new solutions from the ground up
* hands\-on experience leveraging ai\-assisted development tools such as claude code, github copilot, openai codex, cursor, or similar to accelerate development, code review, and testing workflows
* experience with modern front\-end frameworks such as angular, react, vue, or blazor with a strong understanding of contemporary web development is desired
* experience working in a blend of on\-prem and cloud environments
* experience with restful and/or grpc api design
* skillful in writing unit and integration tests using xunit
* expertise in sql server or equivalent relational database experience
* practical experience using entity framework core or a comparable orm
* experience working in an agile / scrum team environment
* familiarity with containerization (docker) and modern source control workflows (git) is a plus


responsibilities:  

  

*eligible candidates must have a fundamental understanding of and demonstrated experience with:*

* service\-oriented and microservices architectures
* modern software design patterns and clean architecture principles
* infrastructure, devops, and infrastructure\-as\-code practices
* message queues, event\-driven systems \& microservices
* database design, modeling and implementation (sql)
* web and application server configuration \& administration
* integrating and responsibly applying ai tooling within the software development lifecycle
* *in this role you will:*
	+ assist and/or lead efforts with system architecture and technical design
	+ assist and/or lead efforts in database design and construction in ms\-sql server, mysql, postgresql, oracle and others
	+ assist and/or lead efforts as a key contributor in the application development functional area
	+ write clean, testable, maintainable code and participate in peer code reviews
	+ assist and mentor other team members where appropriate


optional

* experience working in azure using app services, key vault, azure functions, azure storage or others
* experience with azure devops and working with azure pipelines or similar ci/cd tooling or the desire to learn

title: Senior Applied AI Engineer
description:
### **about parametrix**



parametrix is a 100% employee\-owned consulting firm helping clients deliver resilient infrastructure, vibrant and livable communities, and environmentally sustainable solutions. we are a team of professional construction managers, engineers, management consultants, planners, scientists, and surveyors dedicated to delivering outstanding client service. we build lasting partnerships and collaborate with our clients to envision possibilities and create tomorrow, together.



recognized as a top workplace, we're committed to a culture that values work\-life balance, professional growth, and the well\-being of our people.

### **about the opportunity**



parametrix is seeking a senior applied ai engineer to join our digital services team. in this role, you'll design, build, and deliver practical ai solutions that help improve the way our employees work. working on our established azure\-based ai platform, you'll develop ai agents, applications, and reusable digital assets while partnering with teams across the firm to drive successful adoption of enterprise ai capabilities.



this is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who enjoys translating business opportunities into scalable, secure ai solutions and helping people embrace new technologies. you'll collaborate with technical and business stakeholders to identify high\-value use cases, deliver production\-ready applications, and support the successful integration of ai into day\-to\-day workflows.



this position offers flexible work arrangements, including hybrid work from any parametrix office location or remote work from within the united states.


**work authorization:** applicants must be legally authorized to work in the united states at the time of application. parametrix does not sponsor employment visas for this position now or in the future.


**your role on the team:**


**design and build ai solutions**


* design, develop, and deploy ai agents and applications using claude, chatgpt, azure ai foundry, and microsoft copilot.
* create and maintain reusable ai assets, including custom gpts, claude skills, and copilot agents, that enable employees to effectively leverage ai in their daily work.
* integrate ai solutions with enterprise systems, microsoft 365, rest apis, and business data to deliver secure, reliable, and context\-aware experiences.
* develop production\-ready applications with a focus on code quality, testing, documentation, reliability, and maintainability.
* implement validation, evaluation, and monitoring processes that ensure ai solutions produce accurate and dependable results.


**collaborate and support adoption**


* partner with teams across the firm to identify opportunities where ai can improve business processes and operational efficiency.
* work with technical and business stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into clear solution requirements.
* create documentation, training materials, and best practices that support successful implementation and ongoing use of ai solutions.
* ensure solutions align with the firm's security, governance, and data management standards.
* contribute to the firm's applied ai community of practice by sharing knowledge, staying current with emerging ai technologies, and recommending practical innovations.


**what you bring to the team:**



we're looking for someone with a combination of strong software engineering skills, applied ai experience, and the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams. strong software engineering is the foundation for this role, and the ai and platform skills below build on it. we recognize candidates may bring deeper expertise in some areas than others.


* experience designing, developing, testing, and deploying production python using modern development practices and git\-based workflows.
* demonstrated success building ai\-powered applications, including prompt engineering, agent workflows, and large language model (llm) integrations.
* hands\-on experience with one or more leading ai platforms, including claude, chatgpt, azure ai foundry, or microsoft copilot.
* ability to develop reusable ai solutions, such as custom gpts, copilot agents, or similar ai assets that support business users.
* experience integrating applications with rest apis, enterprise systems, and business data sources.
* familiarity with modern ai development concepts such as retrieval\-augmented generation (rag), vector search, model context protocol (mcp), or related technologies.
* ability to collaborate with business stakeholders to identify needs, implement solutions, and support organizational adoption.
* understanding of security, governance, and responsible ai practices within enterprise environments.


**preferred qualifications**


* microsoft azure ai engineer associate certification or comparable ai\-related certification.
* demonstrated experience building ai agents in c\#/.net, particularly using microsoft agent framework or semantic kernel on azure.
* proficiency with react, typescript, or other modern front\-end development frameworks.
* working knowledge of microsoft copilot studio, power platform, or other low\-code development platforms.
* ability to work with sql and enterprise business data.
* background in the architecture, engineering, and construction (aec) industry or another professional services environment.
* familiarity with ai agent orchestration frameworks and related technologies.

### **why join parametrix?**


**employee ownership \& great benefits:** as a 100% employee\-owned company, you will share in and contribute to parametrix's success. you will earn stock in your employee stock ownership plan (esop) account and be an important contributor to our collective achievements.



our benefits include:


* comprehensive healthcare (medical, dental, vision, short\- \& long\-term disability insurance)
* employee stock ownership plan (financial profit sharing)
* performance\-based bonuses
* 401(k) plan
* paid time off (both vacation \& sick/wellness time accruals)
* paid holidays
* parental bonding leave


**exciting, award\-winning project work:** our work earns recognition for its innovation and positive impact on communities, giving you the opportunity to contribute to projects that make a difference. learn more at https://www.parametrix.com/our\-work/


**flexible work arrangements:** we understand the importance of work\-life balance and offer flexible work arrangements to support our employee\-owners' diverse needs. whether it is hybrid, remote, or in\-office, we provide options that allow you to work in a way that best suits your lifestyle while staying connected and engaged with your team.


compensation is determined by factors such as education, experience, location, and role. as employee\-owners, we are eligible for performance\-based bonuses and our salaries are reviewed annually. we value transparency and look forward to discussing our compensation structure.


### **our commitment to you**



parametrix is committed to being an inclusive workplace, where team members of all backgrounds and experiences are welcome. as an equal opportunity employer, it is our policy and culture to provide opportunities to all persons based on merit and fitness to perform job duties. employment decisions are based solely on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, creed, national or ethnic origin, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, religion, age (40 or older, as protected under the adea), disability (including physical, mental, or sensory), genetic information (including testing and characteristics), protected veteran status, or any other status or characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws or regulations.



at parametrix, we are dedicated to encouraging an inclusive and accessible workplace. if you need any accommodations during the application or interview process, please let us know, and we will work with you to ensure your needs are met. we welcome and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Sensors & Embodied Intelligence

description:

* owning and modernizing our ci/cd pipeline, including a strategic migration from on\-premise to aws.
* supporting our software quality assurance team by provisioning, configuring, and maintaining qa test environments.

 **what you’ll do**


**ci/cd pipeline ownership**


* maintain, improve, and modernize all aspects of the indica labs jenkins\-based ci/cd pipeline.
* lead the migration of the ci/cd pipeline from on\-premise infrastructure to aws.
* maintain build servers, container images, and related infrastructure.
* diagnose and resolve build, deployment, and upgrade issues across the ci/cd pipeline and at client sites.
* integrate static analysis tools, code signing, cybersecurity vulnerability scans, sbom generation, automated tests, and stakeholder notifications into the pipeline.


**software quality assurance (sqa) environment support**


* provision, configure, harden, and maintain software quality assurance test environments.
* deploy indica labs software into sqa environments and troubleshoot environment\-related issues for the sqa team.


**cross\-functional collaboration**


* work closely with development teams, sqa, cloud services, and technical solutions to align on best practices and internal standards.
* contribute to development tasks where capacity and priorities allow.

  


**what you bring (required)**


* bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering, mathematics, or a related field — or equivalent professional experience.
* three (3\) years of professional experience as a devops engineer.
* comprehensive understanding of ci/cd pipelines and best practices.
* scripting proficiency in powershell and/or other scripting languages (bash, python, etc.).
* intermediate\-level security and networking knowledge.
* hands on aws experience (ec2, s3, ecs, iam)
* demonstrable experience applying best practices to build environments and ci/cd pipelines.
* solid understanding of ai and ai coding assistants and where they add value.
* working experience with both windows and linux environments, including basic system administration: configuring services, installing and updating software, and diagnosing system and network issues.

**nice to have**


* five (5\) years of professional experience as a devops engineer.
* thorough understanding of jenkins, gitlab and experience building efficient, scalable, and robust ci/cd pipelines including artifact management and multi\-pipeline orchestration.
* experience with jenkins, gitlab, wixsharp/wix installers, and package managers.
* experience with .net build tooling (msbuild, dotnet cli) and nuget package management.
* experience supporting enterprise\-wide build environments.
* experience with iac tooling (terraform)
* **preference will be given to candidates currently residing in new mexico and will be open to applicants outside of new mexico only after august 1, 2026\.**

title: Associate Data and Cost Modeling Analyst - Government Estimating
description:
at boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. we’re committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that’s welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. find your future with us.


the boeing company is seeking an **associate data and cost modeling analyst \- government estimating** to join the analytics \& data intelligence team in **hazelwood, mo**.


this challenging role will support development of ai\-powered estimating tools, cost model development, and data collection, organization, and analysis, particularly working with unstructured data.


our ideal candidate is a curious, collaborative problem\-solver who communicates clearly and prioritizes the team; they bring hands\-on experience in ai, machine learning, algorithmic problem\-solving techniques, and statistical modeling to develop analytical solutions. they have practical experience with data analysis, normalization and standardization, building etls and data pipelines and tools, and handling unstructured data.


**position responsibilities:**


* work with boeing data systems (ire, eas, pmas, cspr, etc.) to create databases and data tools, understanding how our different data sources connect to link them for various data tool solutions, managing the etl process
* develop analytical solutions for imperfect datasets
* work with and understand datasets from a variety of programs/platforms and systems; data normalization
* map data to common baselines to normalize and analyze cross platform data
* leverage large language models (llms) to process and analyze text data.
* implement methods such as retrieval augmented generation (rag) to improve upon the performance of llms
* leverage artificial intelligence (ai) methods, such as neural networks, classifiers, and decision trees, specifically, to power data analysis and solutions for estimating
* code, test, and maintain data tools and analytical models
* support in the design of parametric cost models, dashboards, metrics and reports utilizing standard technologies and statistical computation methodologies that support cost analysis objectives

**basic qualifications (required skill/experience):**


* bachelor’s degree or higher in a quantitative field (e.g. statistics, operations research, information systems, bioinformatics, economics, computational biology, computer science, mathematics, physics, chemistry or similar quantitative fields)
* experience with data modeling tools (e.g. sql, python, spotfire, pyspark, rstudio, databricks, dataiku, airflow, streamsets, tableau), data modeling techniques, and/or data normalization
* 1\+ years of experience in designing and implementing natural language processing (nlp) models using machine learning techniques including neural networks, deep learning and transformer architectures

**preferred qualifications (desired skills/experience):**


* proven experience analyzing large datasets and presenting actionable insights to leadership
* experience with statistical analysis and advanced methods (probability theory/distribution, multivariate analysis, parametric/non\-parametric models, algorithmic computational methods, etc.)
* proficiency with statistical software, programming languages, and databases
* experience with application programming interface (api) design and application
* experience with ai concepts / machine learning (ml): particularly llms (including prompt engineering). natural language processing (nlp), clustering, optimization, and applications in time series analysis, stochastic models, and data mining
* strong technical data analysis background and defense industry experience
